summary: Rediscovery of the same Ahmad Maher Awashra house-fire event already tracked as MAR23-013.
discovery_sources: OCHA 14-27 Mar 2023; WAFA 26 Mar 2023; NAD March 2023; ITIC citing Israeli police inspection
resolution_notes: Duplicate of MAR23-013, not a separate candidate event. Both preserve the same material causation conflict: Palestinian/local and OCHA routes reported settler incendiary attack, while contemporaneous reporting of an Israeli police inspection said an electrical fault caused the fire. No canonical political-violence incident is created absent decisive underlying official/fire evidence.
media_status: Same-event aftermath imagery exists but does not resolve perpetrator/cause; no canonical media card or substitute preview.
